propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) import adapters.jira at nested function scope, violating the backend-neutral reconciler port contract (ADR 0035 §(d)).

Backend Protocol must expose scalar, translation-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) with no vendor-shape parameters; JiraBackend delegates to resolve_jira_settings, and every backend implementor must satisfy the widened Protocol.
The four modules must route through the Backend instance already in scope or through select_backend(load_config()), removing all adapters.jira imports at any nesting depth.
assert_env_ready() raises a new neutral BackendEnvError (RuntimeError subclass) listing missing connection essentials; JiraBackend checks JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN.
apply_handlers catches a new neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError base class; JiraBackend's acli_subprocess.AssigneeNotFoundError subclasses it, preserving assignee soft-fail semantics.
A full-tree AST walker (using ast.walk, not top-level-only traversal) must verify the four modules contain zero adapters.jira imports at any nesting depth.
